Acoustic guitar recordings from tonejs-instruments by N. P. Brosowsky.
https://github.com/nbrosowsky/tonejs-instruments
Original source credited by the library: University of Iowa Musical Instrument Samples.
http://theremin.music.uiowa.edu/
Samples licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/
MP3 files are redistributed unchanged. Playback may transpose them by a few
semitones and adjust volume, fade, and timing to produce notes and strums.
